scenario: A Severity-1 incident remained unresolved after 3 hours. Within the first hour, the provider confirmed and documented that the root cause was an outage at an upstream third-party network provider outside its control. The provider did not escalate to a senior engineer.
policy: The provider must escalate any unresolved Severity-1 incident to a senior engineer after 2 hours, except where the incident's root cause has been positively identified as a third-party network provider outside the provider's control, in which case no escalation obligation applies.
question: Did the provider breach its escalation obligation?
